process: identifier-level exact match on DOI (case-normalized), then arXiv id (version-stripped), then RePEc handle, then OpenAlex / Semantic Scholar internal id; then a same-work merge on a case- and punctuation-insensitive normalized title (protocol section 4.1 CONVENTION). Merging is transitive (union-find over identifier and normalized-title keys).
software: executing agent's Python 3.11 script under the project venv; no reference-manager product used. Script archived at ka-dedup-script.py in this directory.
j6_note: J6 (journal version retained over the working-paper/proceedings twin) was applied to every included record carrying more than one DOI; the retained identifier and the twins are itemized below for the included corpus.
